content:
jordan: customer reports promo code applied in Support Console but credits not showing and they were billed. customer id: acct_9X2, invoice 2026-02-26. they say console showed "grant succeeded" then later an automated charge.
nia: ugh. do we have a backoffice job failure? can someone pull logs for that timestamp?
alex: looking now — noticed a cluster of backoffice errors around 2026-02-26 18:07 UTC. errors: "deadlock detected" and "duplicate key value violates unique constraint grant_id_pkey".
sam: we shipped the grant-table unique-id migration last week. still trying to reproduce locally. may be a race when two admins click grant + auto-reconcile runs.
maria: also saw DB CPU spike due to vacuum job at 18:05, could have increased lock contention. ops window had a long-running maintenance query.
jordan: customer timeline: support clicked "apply promo" at 18:06, UI showed success, they resumed calls, then at 18:09 invoice processed. they need a refund or credits asap.
alex: repro steps I used:
```
# emulate support console action
curl -X POST https://backoffice.internal/grants -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOT" -d '{"account":"acct_9X2","amount":1000,"promo":"SPRING_TRIAL"}'
# then trigger reconcile
python tools/reconcile_grants.py --account acct_9X2
```
When I ran this twice concurrently got a deadlock, one process rolled back and reconcile created an invoice.
sam: ack. probable root cause: migration introduced a new unique constraint but grant creation path isn't idempotent so when a transaction is rolled back the UI still records success and support retries. we should gate the UI to wait for backend-confirmation.
nia: immediate ask: can we (1) issue manual credits to acct_9X2 and (2) refund invoice 2026-02-26-11? Jordan please confirm consent from customer, then we'll proceed.
jordan: customer ok with manual credit + refund. telling them ETA 2h.
maria: ops can roll a DB parameter to reduce vacuum overlap but that’s heavy. smaller change: we can add a transient lock in backoffice API to serialize grants per account. low-risk.
alex: patch ready: add idempotency token enforcement and retry-with-backoff on deadlock. will hotfix to backoffice-canary. deploy-bot: deploy 1769503500 backoffice-canary started by alex.
deploy-bot: backoffice-canary succeeded in us-west-2 at 1769503600, health checks pass.
sam: after canary I re-ran repro and no deadlocks. added a reconciliation job to scan for invoices created within 5m of grant attempts and mark them for review.
jordan: did the manual credit + refund happen?
ia: manual credit issued txn id tx_77C, refund issued ref_44K. I updated the support ticket and CC'd billing.
jordan: thanks. next actions: (a) alex to promote hotfix to prod (b) sam to add automated check to prevent UI-success until DB commit returns (c) ops to monitor DB contention for 24h.
alex: will push to prod in next deploy window (ETA 3h).
sam: i'll open a postmortem PR with repro steps + SQL snippets.
jordan: closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
nia: thanks all — please add any follow-ups to the ticket #SUP-9821 and ping if you need billing playbook.
